readerCopy.body: A need can be acknowledged without turning its inconvenience to someone else into evidence that the need itself is wrong. When the Moon trines Lilith, care and autonomy reinforce each other, making hunger, anger, overstimulation, privacy, jealousy, loneliness, or exhaustion easier to register without immediate self-judgment. A feeling does not have to be noble to contain useful information. The response becomes clearer once the need is allowed to exist before anyone debates how convenient it is.
